reason: I do miss calls on the roof or under a sink, but I'm not putting two grand down on a thing that talks to my customers when I've never heard it handle a real one. I'd probably call the demo line and listen, but I wouldn't pay this month.
objection: A customer gets a wrong answer or a bad booking and I lose the job, and I'm the guinea pig for $2,000 because the first five clients are how he gets his references. Nobody has run this through a winter in my area yet.
would_change_my_mind: A call with a plumber or HVAC guy in Laval who has had it live for a couple of months, with his real before and after missed-call numbers, and no complaints from his customers.
